Top USA eSIM Questions, Answered

What is an eSIM? How does it work?

An eSIM is a digital SIM that simplifies staying connected while traveling abroad, eliminating the need to swap physical SIM cards. More importantly, it means you can avoid expensive roaming charges. Simply download a plan and connect in a few taps!

Is my phone compatible with eSIM?

Most smartphones today support eSIM technology, but there are still a few models that do not. Easily check if your smartphone or tablet is eSIM-compatible using our compatibility checker.

Why choose Sim Local for a USA eSIM?

Sim Local connects you to trusted local networks in 150+ countries including the USA. With a plan from a local provider in the USA, you can ditch slow and expensive roaming products and unlock the fastest possible internet speeds.

How to activate an eSIM

An eSIM can be installed with a few changes in your phone settings—no physical SIM card swapping required! Check out our quick guides for installing on iOS and Android.

How long does it take to activate an eSIM?

The fastest way to install an eSIM is through the Sim Local app. Download a plan and get online in a couple of minutes!

How to get a USA eSIM from Sim Local

Getting an eSIM is super easy! Simply purchase a plan online and follow guided instructions in the app (or email sent to your inbox).

What USA networks can I get an eSIM plan with via Sim Local?

Sim Local brings the big brands to eSIM and in the USA you can choose between Lycamobile or a Simlocal eSIM plan. Visit our networks page to learn more about our networks.

I am travelling across North America, can I also get an eSIM plan for Canada or Mexico?

If you need an eSIM plan for Canada, Mexico or North America, we have got you covered. You can purchase an eSIM plan for those regions or even opt for a global eSIM plan to stay connected across multiple regions.

How does the Sim Local eSIM work?

1

Choose an eSIM plan for your trip

Select the destination you’re traveling to and choose your data plan. Remember to check if your mobile device is compatible.

2

Follow Guided Instructions

Purchase your plan. Install your eSIM 1 day before the trip and follow our step-by-step instructions to install your eSIM.

3

Connect Instantly

When you arrive, you'll connect to the same 4G and 5G networks as the locals!

"Unlimited" should mean freedom, not small print.

Many networks advertise “unlimited data” but slow you down after just 3GB or 5GB. At SimLocal, you get up to 10GB of full-speed data daily. No buffering, no lag - just smooth streaming, maps that load, and hassle-free sharing, so your trip stays stress-free.

Top USA eSIM Questions, Answered
What is an eSIM? How does it work?
An eSIM is a digital SIM that simplifies staying connected while traveling abroad, eliminating the need to swap physical SIM cards. More importantly, it means you can avoid expensive roaming charges. Simply download a plan and connect in a few taps!
Is my phone compatible with eSIM?
Most smartphones today support eSIM technology, but there are still a few models that do not. Easily check if your smartphone or tablet is eSIM-compatible using our
compatibility checker
.
Why choose Sim Local for a USA eSIM?
Sim Local connects you to trusted local networks in 150+ countries including the USA. With a plan from a local provider in the USA, you can ditch slow and expensive roaming products and unlock the fastest possible internet speeds.
How to activate an eSIM
An eSIM can be installed with a few changes in your phone settings—no physical SIM card swapping required! Check out our quick guides for installing on
iOS
and
Android
.
How long does it take to activate an eSIM?
The fastest way to install an eSIM is through the Sim Local app. Download a plan and get online in a couple of minutes!
How to get a USA eSIM from Sim Local
Getting an eSIM is super easy! Simply purchase a plan online and follow guided instructions in the app (or email sent to your inbox).
What USA networks can I get an eSIM plan with via Sim Local?
Sim Local brings the big brands to eSIM and in the USA you can choose between
Lycamobile
or a Simlocal eSIM plan. Visit our networks page to learn more about
our networks
.
